message: hermes compile: V_bad is a V_name runtime (V_licence): V_reason (source: V_source)
why: The licence red line is a closed set, checked again on the plan surface as defence in depth: the --link-* inputs were already screened before the plan, but the built-in network archive is a separate input path. A hit means this artifact would statically carry a runtime whose licence forbids distributing it. Which runtime entered the link is the question — not what the symbols look like, since mangling is both a false positive and a false negative.
fix: link an equivalent implementation whose licence permits distribution instead
read the (source: …) URL in the message — the rule names its own authority, and the exception conditions are stated there
